description: Creates an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP cluster peer relationship from a file system to another ONTAP cluster. Cluster peering lets the file system replicate data to and from the peer cluster with SnapMirror. Create a cluster peer on each side, with the same passphrase, to complete the relationship.
